01-cradle: This is your first heart. Tag the gold in the earth, raise a treasury, a lair and a hatchery, and be ready. Heroes will come.
02-siege: The surface has found you. Build an army, hold the heart, and break the Lord of the Land.
03-rival: Another keeper shares this rock. Take the gold between you, then dig until their heart is dust.
04-cinder: A river of fire splits the deep. Bridge it, survive the heroes at your gate, and end the rival beyond the lava.
05-last: The last keep is walled in living rock. The Lord of the Land and a rival keeper both want your heart. Take theirs first.
unpaid: Your creatures are unpaid. They will not forget.
treasury_full: Your treasury can hold no more gold.
need_treasury: Gold is piling up. Build a treasury.
breaching: The enemy is breaching your walls.

victory: It is done. The deep is yours.
leaving: A creature has abandoned your dungeon.

armageddon: Armageddon. Every soul answers in blood.

scavenger: The scavenger has stolen a soul for you.
enemy_heart: The rival heart has been destroyed.
